Subject: Severe latency and 5xx spike — we need immediate evidence and retention guarantees

Hi Priyom / Marissa,

We experienced a sustained latency spike and elevated 5xx rate on our production route between 08:22 - 08:58 PT this morning; customer-facing throughput dropped ~35% during that window and a number of payment authorizations were delayed. Our SREs captured traces that point at gateway timeouts. We need: (1) full runtime logs for the window including per-request trace IDs, (2) a clear statement of how long those logs will be retained and the chain-of-custody for any artifacts you provide, and (3) confirmation you will preserve the original, un-redacted artifacts for our audit team.

Alice (cc'd) may loop in legal for formal evidence requests. Please treat this as high priority — our execs are already on the thread.

Thanks,
Greenline Ops

- I asked infra to snapshot runtime logs and export the tracing payloads (Priyom).
- Marissa will coordinate the audit index and delivery method (Marissa).
- Monica from Customer Success will coordinate preservation requests and LOE with your legal team (Monica).

Best,
Priyom

Subject: INTERNAL: Evidence packet for Greenline — scope and custody

Folks — moving to internal coordination. Greenline saw a throughput/latency outage 08:22–08:58 PT. They asked for raw runtime logs, traces, retention statement, and chain-of-custody. Execs are watching. Please keep this internal-only until we confirm the delivery channel.

We need to assemble an 'incident evidence packet' including:
- Raw runtime logs (host/gpu timestamps, request IDs, error stacks) for the route greenline-prod-ingest, window 2026-12-05T08:15:00–2026-12-05T09:00:00 PT
- KV cache snapshot and batching metrics for that window
- Router fallback events and model-variant switch logs
- Tokenization and request/response size metrics

Security asks:
- Produce an index with SHA256 hashes for each artifact.
- Place raw artifacts into a read-only bucket and record the service account that accessed/created the bundle.
- Retention statement: we'll propose retaining raw artifacts for 90 days, with longer archival retention on request.

Rishi: can you confirm how long the runtime logs are retained by default for Dedicated customers, and whether we have any PII in the traces that requires redaction before handoff?
Marissa: please own the evidence index and delivery (signed manifest + checksums).
Evelyn: loop in Legal/Security on preservation/privilege language; I expect Greenline legal to want a formal preservation notice.

We will aim to ship a preliminary bundle within 12 hours; finalized within 24.

- Priyom
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T10:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Evidence packet for Greenline — scope and custody

Priyom — quick technical notes:
- Default runtime log retention for Dedicated customers is 30 days. For hosted API customers it's 14 days by default; in either case we can uplift retention for legal preservation.
- Traces may contain user-provided inputs in tokenized form. For Greenline (we are processing PII-limited payment tokens), we should assume token-level payloads could be sensitive. We can provide raw traces under legal hold; if Greenline wants redacted copies for broader distribution we will produce them as a secondary artifact.
- We'll include SHA256 checksums and an audit manifest. I will capture the service account identity and ACLs.

Estimate: creating the read-only bundle + manifest and delivering to a secured share — ~6 hours. Generating a second redacted package — additional 4 hours.

-Rishi
Senior Infra Engineer
